tasks.title: Merged-sibling filter in check-scope CLI
definition_of_done: reference-impl/lib/cli.ts check-scope subcommand skips any sibling task whose status equals 'merged' when loading sibling scopes, at the CLI/query boundary before calling classifyFiles

reference-impl/tests/cli.test.ts contains 2 new test cases: (1) a sibling with status 'merged' and overlapping files_touched does not produce a contested result; (2) a sibling with status 'review' and overlapping files_touched still produces a contested result
npm test in reference-impl/ passes with all new cases green
acceptance_criteria: cloverleaf-cli check-scope skips siblings whose status === 'merged' when reading sibling task docs from main
Both new cli.test.ts cases pass: merged sibling is not contested, non-merged sibling is still contested
lib/scope-check.ts classifyFiles function is not modified — filter lives entirely in cli.ts
npm test exits 0 with all 2 new cases green

tasks.title: Partial-scope warning in Plan-agent gate-pending summary
definition_of_done: reference-impl/prompts/plan.md contains a count instruction near the existing edge-groupings guidance directing the Plan agent to count tasks where scope.files_touched is absent or empty and list them under a warning line in the gate-pending summary

reference-impl/prompts/plan.md contains the literal warning-template line appended to the gate-pending summary template: '⚠ Tasks without scope.files_touched: <CLV-XX, CLV-YY>' with the advisory note that the walker will silent-skip enforcement on undeclared tasks
The template line is documented as omitted entirely when every task has non-empty scope.files_touched
reference-impl/tests/skills.test.ts contains 1 new regression test case asserting both the literal count-instruction sentence and the literal warning-template string are present in prompts/plan.md
npm test in reference-impl/ passes with all new cases green
acceptance_criteria: prompts/plan.md contains the literal count instruction sentence directing the Plan agent to count tasks where scope.files_touched is absent or an empty array
prompts/plan.md contains the literal warning-template string '⚠ Tasks without scope.files_touched: <CLV-XX, CLV-YY>'
1 new skills.test.ts regression test passes asserting both literal strings are present in prompts/plan.md
No lib or CLI files are modified by this task
npm test exits 0 with the new case green
